target: SRC-family / anti-apoptotic pathways of senescent cells
axis: Senolytic — clear the senescent burden driving progeroid pathology
regulatory: FDA approved; pediatric indication from age 1, one of them in combination with chemotherapy
mechanistic_link: BubR1 insufficiency is the founding progeroid/senolytic model. In BubR1^H/L1002P mice — a reduced-protein allele plus a C-lobe pseudokinase missense, the same allelic architecture as this proband — progeroid severity tracked with SASP complexity in skeletal muscle (PMID 31738183). Senolytic clearance improves BubR1-hypomorph phenotypes.
caveats: Quercetin is a supplement, not an FDA drug. No senolytic trial in MVA or in children. Dasatinib myelosuppression and effusion risk in a child already on cytotoxic chemotherapy. Senescence is also a tumour-suppressive program — clearing it in a cancer-predisposition syndrome is not risk-free.

axis: Normalise the mTORC1 hyperactivity documented in BubR1-mutant mice
regulatory: Both FDA approved with established pediatric use
mechanistic_link: Sarcopenia predisposition in BubR1-mutant mice correlates with mTORC1 hyperactivity (PMID 31738183). mTOR inhibition postpones premature ageing in independent progeroid models (PMID 32282093, 31312666) and everolimus increases autophagy in laminopathies (PMID 29581305).
caveats: The BubR1-mTOR relationship is not directional-consistent: in hepatocellular carcinoma high BUB1B UPregulates mTORC1 (PMID 32977361), the opposite of the mouse progeroid finding. No rapamycin experiment in a BubR1 model was retrieved. Immunosuppression in a child on chemotherapy.

target: Ribosomal decoding of the premature TGA at codon 737
axis: Address the causal lesion — restore full-length protein from the null allele
regulatory: Ataluren is NOT an approved medicine: 0 FDA applications, and the EU conditional authorisation was not renewed on 28 March 2025. UK availability and EU Article 5(1) named-patient routes persist. Aminoglycosides are approved antibiotics, off-label for this purpose.
mechanistic_link: The PTC is TGA with +4 A — TGA is the most readthrough-permissive stop class, and TGA-A is a context specific compounds are reported to handle (PMID 41730613, 42034525). The disease is dose-dependent, so partial restoration could cross threshold.
caveats: Readthrough at UGA inserts Trp, Cys or Arg. Leu737 is 95.5% conserved across 247 vertebrate orthologs and 90% buried; none of the three products occurs naturally at this position, and all three are non-conservative there. NMD further limits substrate availability (PMID 34828417). Chronic aminoglycoside exposure carries oto- and nephrotoxicity in a child receiving other toxic agents.

mechanistic_link: Aneuploid tumour cells depend more on residual SAC function (PMID 33505028, 33505027), which is the standard rationale for targeting aneuploid cancers.
caveats: The therapeutic window of this strategy assumes normal cells have an intact checkpoint. In constitutional BUB1B insufficiency the proband's normal tissue is itself checkpoint-compromised, so the window may be absent or inverted. We flag this so it is not pursued by analogy to sporadic aneuploid tumours.
